item.title: NHL Rumors: Bruins Trade Offer For Rasmus Andersson Revealed
item.description: RG.org's James Murphy has reported the Boston Bruins have already floated a serious framework to the Calgary Flames for Rasmus Andersson: Mason Lohrei plus a first round pick. The Flames are believed to be trying to land this deal before the NHL Olympic break (Feb. 6 to 25), with Elliotte Friedman noting the talks have ramped up again. item.title: Breaking: NY Rangers To Work With Artemi Panarin's Camp on a Trade

item.title: TRADE: Sharks trade Masters, draft pick to Hurricanes
item.description: Friday saw a minor trade go down in the NHL, as the San Jose Sharks and Carolina Hurricanes pulled off a trade. The Hurricanes acquired minor-league defenceman Kyle Masters and a 2026 fourth-round draft pick for the Sharks 2027 fifth-round selection.This move has other implications as the Sharks wanted to move out Masters to clear a contract so they could activate top prospect Michael Misa.
